svg.title: Board after the estimates
svg.desc: Estimates (assume one node: ~10k writes/s, ~10 TB of disk): / 1B a day / 10^5 s = 10k/s, peak 100k/s -> writes spread over several nodes / 1 KB x 1B = 1 TB a day, 30 days = 30 TB -> data spread over several nodes / 1 status check per 10 messages -> mostly writes

text.tspan: Estimates (assume one node: ~10k writes/s, ~10 TB of disk):
1 KB x 1B = 1 TB a day, 30 days = 30 TB
